solution: ⓑ conducting → conducted (동사구 has revealed에 대한 주 어 Research를 수식하는 분사구를 이루는 분사가 쓰일 수 있 으나, 수식받는 명사 Research가 ‘행해진’ 대상이며 뒤에 이어 진 목적어가 없으므로, 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 conducting 을 수동을 나타내는 과거분사 conducted로 고친다.) ⓕ caused → causing (완전한 절(This ~ flats) 뒤에 접속사 없이 동 사(구)가 연결될 수 없으므로 흐름상 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구 문을 이끄는 분사 형태가 되어야 하며, 원인에 해당하는 앞 절의 내용 이 ‘초래한’ 주체이고 뒤에 목적어로 명사구 a loss of biodiversity가 있으므로, caused를 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 causing으로 고친다.) ⓖ Had it not been for → Were it not for[If it were not for] 또는 Without[But for] (주절에 ‘조동사 과거형+동사원형’인 would fail이 쓰였으며 흐름상 과거 사실이 아닌 현재 사실과 반 대되는 일을 가정하고 있으므로, ‘~이 없다면, …할 것이다’를 뜻 하는 가정법 과거 표현인 ‘Were it not for[If it were not for/But for/Without] ~, 주어+조동사 과거형+동사원형 …’을 써야 한다. 따라서 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하는 가정법 과거완료 표현인 ‘Had it not been for[If it had not been for/Without/But for] ~, 주어+조동사 과거형+have+p.p. …(~가 없었다면, …했을 것이다)’ 의 Had it not been for를 Were it not for, If it were not for, But for, Without 중 하나로 고친다.)

Email is one of the most widely used forms of
communication today. Did you know that the
seemingly innocent act of looking through emails or
checking your inbox has an environmental impact?
(A) Because the centers use electricity to run the
servers and to cool down the large amounts of
heat that they generate, they consume a significant
amount of fossil fuels. Mike Berners-Lee, the
British researcher and author of How Bad Are
Bananas?: The Carbon Footprint of Everything,
looked at our average email traffic.
(B) In reality, email travels through an energy-consuming
network, contributing to climate change on our
planet. Storing countless email messages in data
centers creates carbon emissions. These data
centers rely on huge servers to store and access
data at all times.
(C) For example, a short phone-to-phone email has a
carbon footprint of 0.2g of CO₂ emissions. But,
a long email, which takes about ten minutes to
write and three minutes to read on a computer,
has a footprint of 17g of CO₂ emissions. So,
something as simple as deleting unnecessary
email messages can help to save the Earth.
